# Yappman Data

> Dated grocery shelf-price indices for the UK and Australia, free under CC BY 4.0, with data extracts. Not CPI; not affiliated with any retailer.

## Free data
- [UK Online Shelf-Price Index](https://data.yappman.com/shelf-price-index/): Weekly index of posted online shelf prices at Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda and Aldi. Base 100 at 2026-W42 after the skipped week 41. CC BY 4.0.
- [UK Online Shelf-Price Index: how it is measured](https://data.yappman.com/shelf-price-index/method/): How the UK Online Shelf-Price Index is built: matched products at Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda and Aldi, a Jevons index chained week on week, the ratio-3 rule, base weeks, cadence and changelog.
- [UK Online Shelf-Price Index: data dictionary](https://data.yappman.com/shelf-price-index/data-dictionary/): Fields, record types, statuses and meta of the UK Online Shelf-Price Index dataset (uk-shelf-price-index), with the CSV and JSON download links. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
- [AU Online Shelf-Price Index](https://data.yappman.com/au-shelf-price-index/): Weekly index of posted online shelf prices at Coles, Woolworths and Aldi Australia, in AUD. Base 100 at 2026-W41. Normally updated on Monday. CC BY 4.0.
- [AU Online Shelf-Price Index: how it is measured](https://data.yappman.com/au-shelf-price-index/method/): How the AU Online Shelf-Price Index is built: matched products at Coles, Woolworths and Aldi Australia, a like-for-like Jevons headline, the ratio-3 rule, Coles coverage, cadence and changelog.
- [AU Online Shelf-Price Index: data dictionary](https://data.yappman.com/au-shelf-price-index/data-dictionary/): Fields, record types, statuses and meta of the AU Online Shelf-Price Index dataset (au-shelf-price-index), with the CSV and JSON download links. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
- [UK Christmas dinner basket 2026](https://data.yappman.com/christmas-basket/): A fixed Christmas dinner basket of 27 items at Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda and Aldi: posted online shelf prices read from pinned product pages, weekly totals and item by item.
- [Council tax Band D reference table](https://data.yappman.com/council-tax/): Band D council tax for England, Wales and Scotland, 2025-26 and 2026-27, with nine English regions for 2026-27. 20 rows, CSV download, sources and Open Government Licence attribution.
- [Median sold prices by postcode district](https://data.yappman.com/sold-prices/): A free monthly table of median sold prices by postcode district for England and Wales, from HM Land Registry Price Paid Data, as CSV and JSON under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
- [Gross rental yield by local authority](https://data.yappman.com/rental-yield/): A free monthly table of gross rental yield by local authority and property type for England and Wales, from ONS private rents and HM Land Registry sold prices, as CSV and JSON under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
- [Grocery price snapshots MCP server](https://data.yappman.com/mcp/): A free, read-only MCP server for AI assistants: the UK and Australian shelf-price indices and the UK daily basket, as static snapshots under CC BY 4.0.

## Actors on the Apify Store
- [Our Actors on the Apify Store](https://data.yappman.com/actors/): The Yappman Data Actors on the Apify Store, with one line on what each does: UK and AU supermarket prices, UK property listings, Google Hotels rates, public contracts, LEI lookup, UK importers and exporters, UK sponsor register changes, CQC England care locations and the CRICOS register lookup (Australia). Prices and terms are on each Store page.
- [UK supermarket prices](https://apify.com/yappman/uk-supermarket-price-scraper)
- [AU supermarket prices](https://apify.com/yappman/au-supermarket-price-scraper)
- [UK property listings](https://apify.com/yappman/uk-property-listings)
- [Google Hotels rates](https://apify.com/yappman/google-hotels-prices)
- [Public contracts](https://apify.com/yappman/contracts-lookup)
- [LEI lookup](https://apify.com/yappman/lei-lookup)
- [CRICOS register lookup (Australia)](https://apify.com/yappman/cricos-register)
- [UK importers and exporters](https://apify.com/yappman/uk-importers-exporters)
- [UK sponsor register changes](https://apify.com/yappman/uk-sponsor-register-changes)
- [CQC England care locations](https://apify.com/yappman/cqc-register)

## Method, quality and notices
- [Methodology](https://data.yappman.com/methodology/): How the Yappman Data series work: what we provide, the fields in each row, how the data is collected, how it is delivered, and due diligence.
- [Data quality](https://data.yappman.com/data-quality/): How complete and accurate our Actors' data is: barcode coverage, match accuracy, run success rate and field completeness for UK grocery, AU grocery, hotels and property, with known gaps stated plainly.
- [Notices](https://data.yappman.com/notices/): Announced changes to Yappman Data products, posted before they ship. Each notice gives the date it was announced and the earliest date it ships.
- [YappmanData-PriceFacts: our shelf-price collector](https://data.yappman.com/bot/): Who sends requests with the YappmanData-PriceFacts user agent, how they are paced, and how a site owner asks us to stop.

## Press, licence and contact
- [Press](https://data.yappman.com/press/): For journalists and writers: what the UK Online Shelf-Price Index is, how to cite it, what CC BY 4.0 allows, the latest finding, and who to contact.
- [Where to get UK supermarket price data: free and paid, compared](https://data.yappman.com/guides/uk-supermarket-price-data/): UK supermarket price data compared: ONS statistics, the Warwick and LSE research data, a Kaggle time series, the Which? and Trolley trackers, and our weekly CC BY 4.0 index. What each covers and whether you can download it.
- [Privacy](https://data.yappman.com/privacy/): What personal data the Yappman Data website collects, why, and your choices, including analytics, server logs and what we keep if you email us; and, for people whose details appear in the public registers our feeds and lookups use, what we hold, why, and how to ask for it to be removed.
- Contact: info@yappman.com

## Optional
- [Demos](https://data.yappman.com/demos/): Short screen recordings of the Yappman Data Actors on the Apify Store: UK and Australian supermarkets and property listings.
